title: astrantia major subsp. elatior
intro: Astrantia major subsp. elatior, commonly known as Masterwort, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits of reducing pain, fighting off infections, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Masterwort include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Masterwort include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
